# Motion helpers for later runs. The current target is read from proprio at the start of each move.
ROT=np.array([0.0,1.0,0.0,0.0])
def pose(x,y,z): return np.array([x,y,z,*ROT],dtype=np.float32)
def move(r, target, speed=.05, name='', cameras=['practice_cam','side_cam']):
    p=np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=['side_cam'],video='none').meta['proprio']['now'][7:14],dtype=float)
    n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(target)[:3]-p[:3])/(speed*.05))))
    # There is a limit of 10 seconds per call.
    if n>190:
        halfway=p+(np.asarray(target)-p)*190/n
        move(r,halfway,speed,name+'_part',cameras)
        return move(r,target,speed,name,cameras)
    A=np.linspace(p,target,n+1)[1:]
    res=r.submit('ee_pose',A,dt=.05,cameras=cameras,video='none',note=name)
    print(name,'n',n,'tip',res.meta['proprio']['now'][7:10], 'plan',res.meta.get('plan'),flush=True)
    return res
def hold(r,seconds=.5,name='',cameras=['practice_cam','side_cam']):
    p=r.get_obs(cameras=['side_cam'],video='none').meta['proprio']['now'][7:14]
    res=r.submit('ee_pose',np.repeat([p],round(seconds/.05),axis=0),dt=.05,cameras=cameras,video='none',note=name)
    print(name,'tip',res.meta['proprio']['now'][7:10],flush=True)
    return res
PY

+    D=ndi.distance_transform_edt(comp)
+    np.save(f'/app/output/correction_{index}_walk.npy',np.asarray(walk,dtype=np.int16))
+    # New marks are placed relative to the current best registration shift.
+    A=np.asarray([pixel_pose(v-dy,u-dx,radius_to_z(max(2,D[v,u]*.85))) for v,u in walk],dtype=np.float32)
+    dip_brush(r)

+    move(r,start,speed=.06,name=f'correction_{index}_hover',cameras=['side_cam'])
+    move(r,A[0],speed=.02,name=f'correction_{index}_touch',cameras=['side_cam'])
+    hold(r,.15,f'correction_{index}_settle',cameras=['side_cam'])
+    for j in range(0,len(A),180):
+        res=r.submit('ee_pose',A[j:j+180],dt=.05,cameras=['side_cam'],video='none',note=f'correction_{index}_{j//180}')
+        failures=sum(p.get('ik_failures',0) for p in (res.meta.get('plan') or []))
+        print('correction',index,j,'tip',res.meta['proprio']['now'][7:10],'ik_failures',failures,flush=True)
+        if failures or res.stopped:raise RuntimeError('correction interrupted')
+    end=A[-1].copy();end[2]=.055
+    move(r,end,speed=.025,name=f'correction_{index}_lift',cameras=['side_cam'])
+    move(r,pose(-.1,.155,.08),speed=.08,name=f'correction_{index}_clear',cameras=['side_cam'])
+    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam'],video='frames')
+    Image.fromarray(obs.last['canvas_cam']).save(f'/app/output/main_after_correction_{index}.png')
+    camera_ink_and_shift(obs.last['canvas_cam'])
+    print('status',r.status(),flush=True)
+    return True
